# Preview Screenshot Matrix Artifact

Generated by `tests/e2e/specs/preview-screenshot-matrix.spec.ts` (Plan 16 Step 86).

Contract: [`spec/28-runtime-modes/10-screenshot-matrix.md`](../../../spec/28-runtime-modes/10-screenshot-matrix.md).

## Layout

```
index.json                       # manifest consumed by Step 87 coverage linter
<route-slug>/<scenario>.<seed>.png
```

- Route slug: `/` -> `root`; other paths lose the leading `/` and replace `/` with `-`.
- Scenarios: `null | offline | slow | rate-limited` (INV-PS-01).
- Seeds: `default | empty | error`.

## Do NOT edit by hand

Every PNG and `index.json` is regenerated on each CI run. Local commits of these files are discouraged; treat the folder as build output. The workflow `.github/workflows/preview-screenshot-matrix.yml` uploads them as artifacts.

Authed admin/portal routes are added by Step 93; this folder MUST NOT change layout when those rows land (INV-SM-05).
